description: Bagis toplama: kampanyalar (fundraising campaign), kampanya etkinlikleri (fundraising event) ve takimlar (fundraising team) ile takimlara bagli kampanyalar.

action.description: [update_status] set status of fundraising campaign - reactivate: reactivate finalized campaign - finalize: finalize active campaign - featured: toggle the featured flag on the campaign (requires `featured` body field; up to 6 campaigns per association may be featured; only active campaigns are eligible)

business_account.description: True if payment settings belongs to business account

updated_by__name.description: Account last updated by user name

updated_by_id.description: Account last updated by user id

campaign_id.description: [delete, delete_team_campaign, get, update, update_status, update_team_campaign] Zorunlu: delete, delete_team_campaign, get, update, update_status, update_team_campaign.

default.description: Fundraising team campaign is currently active & default

currency_id.description: [create_team, update_team] Zorunlu: update_team. Fundraising team default Currency ID

data.description: [update] key value pairs of fields and values (see example)

default.description: [create_team_campaign, update_team_campaign] Fundraising team campaign is currently active & default

details.description: [create_team, update_team] Zorunlu: create_team, update_team. Fundraising team description

featured.description: [update_status] Required when `action=featured`. Pass `true` to add the campaign to the Featured Campaigns block, `false` to remove it. Adding beyond the 6-campaign cap responds with HTTP 400.

field.description: [update] field to be updated. Gecerli degerler: title, image, bank_account_list, personal_message, has_target, hide_donor_list, hide_total_donation, has_special_date, phone_show, phone_required, birthday_show, birthday_required, address_show, address_required, tckno_show, tckno_required, message_show, has_target, has_special_date, target, event_date, sub_donation_type_id, payment_settings_id, thanks_mail_id, referral_thanks_mail_id, thanks_sms_id, certificate_id, referral_certificate_id, association_campaign_target_id

has_special_date.description: [create] True if campaign has a event date like birthday, memorial day etc.

hide_donor_list.description: [create] donor list is hidden or not

hide_total_donation.description: [create] total donations is hidden or not

how_many.description: [list, list_teams] How many records should be listed

message_show.description: [create] true if donors may leave a message. Ships enabled, unlike the other *_show flags

query.description: [list, list_teams] search parameter. start with - (minus) char to exclude searched text

status.description:
[create, list, list_teams, update_team] campaign status
- 0: waiting approval
- 1: approved
- 2: rejected
- 3: finalized
- 4: deleted
- 5: waiting extra approval
- 7: archived

target.description: [create, create_event, create_team_campaign, update_event, update_team_campaign] campaign target

target_currency_id.description: [create, create_team_campaign, update_team_campaign] fundraising campaign target currency id
